notes.title: Contra: Operation Galuga out now!
notes.content:
Contra is back - reloaded, reimagined, and reborn - with #Contra: Operation Galuga! Grab your spread shot and run 'n' gun your way through explosive co-op action against the Red Falcon army!

Early adopters will get 10% off and receive 1000 Contra credits to use in the in-game Perk store! 
Early Purchase Bonus is available to obtain until 2024-06-20 23:59(PDT)

Make sure to follow the Steam Community page to keep up to date of all things Contra: Operation Galuga !
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235020/Contra_Operation_Galuga/

notes.title: Link your save data to receive Alternative sound tracks!
notes.content:
You will receive an 'Alternative Sound' bonus for use in the game per the following title(s) you own.

・Contra Anniversary Collection
Link bonus:
Retro Mix (Contra, Super Contra)

・Castlevania Anniversary Collection
Link bonus:
Vania Mix (Castlevania, Dracula II: Simon's Quest, Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse)

・Arcade Classics Anniversary Collection
Link bonus:
Konamix (music from previous KONAMI titles)

Make sure to follow Contra: Operation Galuga for the latest news!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235020/Contra_Operation_Galuga/

notes.title: Contra: Operation Galuga Demo out now!
notes.content:
Unleash hell against Red Falcon's forces right now with the Contra: Operation Galuga playable demo! Blast through a sampling of the game's jungle and waterfall areas solo or co-op to unlock bonuses in the full game when it launches on March 12!

Experience the explosive action through Contra: Operation Galuga's demo and unlock "300 Credits" and "Alternative Sound/WayForward Mix (Contra 4)" in the full game!

Make sure to follow the Steam Community page to keep up to date of all things Contra: Operation Galuga !

notes.title: Regarding the release of Ver.1.04
notes.content:
Ver.1.04 which has been released today (April 11th, 2023 JST) will includes the following patches:
・Fixed an issue where key settings could not be made.
・Fixed an issue where the game screen was not displaying correctly.

notes.title: Regarding the release of Ver.1.03
notes.content:
Ver.1.03 which has been released today (July 12th, 2022 JST) will include the following patches:
・Fixed the issue in Ver.1.02 where the game on occasion did not boot up properly.
・Fixed the issue where the game on occasion did not boot up properly when the user is offline.

notes.title: Regarding the known issues with Ver.1.0.2
notes.content:
Due to some issues found in Ver.1.0.2(released on June 29th, 2022), we will release Ver.1.0.1 until those issues have been fixed.

We deeply apologize for this inconvenience to those who have purchased the game. We ask for your patience while the team continually work towards resolving these issues.

notes.title: Ver.1.02 June 29, 2022
notes.content:
-Fixed the problems that occurred in Ver.1.01, such as various settings not working and the game screen not being displayed.
-Added support for managing save data locally and in the Steam Auto-Cloud.
